scope: Empirical studies and economic loops; one bounded discovery pass

coverage.counting_rule: Only the four distinct priority works count toward this workstream's assigned reading target. Revisions, citation mentions, searches, explorer pages and metadata triage do not add priority reads.
coverage.reading_limitations: Read all available extracted priority text, including methods, results, limitations, references and appendices where present. PDF extraction has duplicated/out-of-order passages and damaged equations/tables; raster figures were not visually audited. Full available-text reading is not independent numerical reproduction.

budget.note: Pagination is charged per fetch. Failed SSRN fetch is charged. No purchases, packages, servers, signatures or transaction submissions.

assigned_sources.title: Aerodrome Finance
assigned_sources.publication_date_basis: Bibliography year, not verified website publication date
assigned_sources.triage: Potential Base liquidity-venue context; homepage metadata establishes neither historical spreads nor entrant profitability.

assigned_sources.title: A Tale of Two Arbitrages

data_window.exclusions: USDC depeg days excluded by authors

assigned_sources.triage: Risk-taking and liquidity explain non-atomic execution. CEX midpoint markouts are not actual off-chain fills or complete actor net PnL.

assigned_sources.title: Flash Boys 2.0: Frontrunning in Decentralized Exchanges, Miner Extractable Value, and Consensus Instability
assigned_sources.triage: Attack/consensus-risk context only; excluded from strategy construction. Its appearance in read papers' references is not an independent read.

assigned_sources.title: Rolling in the Shadows: Analyzing the Extraction of MEV Across Layer-2 Rollups
assigned_sources.triage: Relevant L2 measurement predecessor, cited by newer work. Not read here; no numerical results or current access claims adopted.

assigned_sources.title: MEV Capture Through Time-Advantaged Arbitrage

data_window.description: Binance perpetual top-of-book price series used in simulations, not observed Timeboost trading

assigned_sources.deployment_status_at_publication: Timeboost proposal; LP value-capture adaptation also proposed
assigned_sources.triage: Timing rights change gross economics; auction cost, actual hedge execution and restrictive model assumptions prevent treating simulation outputs as entrant net returns.

assigned_sources.title: Non-Atomic Arbitrage in Decentralized Finance
assigned_sources.triage: One-sided heuristic classification, not observed cross-venue hedges. Private visibility, established-token and first-in-pool filters bias coverage; fee payments are not full actor net profit.

assigned_sources.title: A Large Scale Study of the Ethereum Arbitrage Ecosystem
assigned_sources.triage: Executed transaction identification is distinct from candidate opportunities and private-fork counterfactuals. Token compatibility failures and overlapping campaigns invalidate naive opportunity summation. Attack discussions are context only.

assigned_sources.title: Welcome to the Optimism Docs
assigned_sources.publication_date_basis: Bibliography year, not verified document revision
assigned_sources.triage: Potential chain and settlement context; welcome page alone would not establish a tradable basis or current protocol safety.

assigned_sources.title: AUCIL: An Inclusion List Design for Rational Parties
assigned_sources.triage: Consensus/inclusion-design context, not direct evidence of a deployed entrant-accessible cross-chain economic loop.

additional_sources.title: The Express Lane to Spam and Centralization: An Empirical Analysis of Arbitrum's Timeboost
additional_sources.triage: Observed deployment and 2026 secondary-market changes, not a new free edge. Ten-second highest-profit Binance markouts are estimates with hindsight, not demonstrated causal hedge fills.

additional_sources.title: Introducing: BAM's Direct Bundle Ingest

data_window.description: Provider comparison: Sep 3-20 and Sep 20-Oct 7, 2026; incomplete epoch excluded

additional_sources.deployment_status: Provider says live on Solana mainnet for early cohort during preceding month; request-access whitelist
additional_sources.triage: Relevant recent non-EVM execution-path change; landing metrics and validator rewards are provider claims, not entrant net PnL. Explicit whitelist blocks assuming universal direct access.

additional_sources.title: Bunny Hops and Blockchain Stops: Cross-Chain MEV Detection With N-Hops
additional_sources.triage: Newer related work, old sample. Five-minute adjacent-step and two-percent value-continuity filters plus aggregator exclusions constrain recall. Reported gross endpoint differences are not complete fee/funding-adjusted profit.

additional_sources.title: Cross-Chain Arbitrage: The Next Frontier of MEV in Decentralized Finance
additional_sources.triage: Appendix G supplies six loan transaction links. Does not resolve reported 0xEf6c day in searchable text; paper's 0.5 ETH statement conflicts with linked sale overview.

additional_sources.title: Pandora's Box: Cross-Chain Arbitrages in the Realm of Blockchain Interoperability
additional_sources.triage: No exact Ef6c/GNO/ZGAP/DOS/21-trade witness recovered. Negative text search is not proof of absence; figures were not OCRed.

additional_sources.title: The Price of Interoperability: Exploring Cross-Chain Bridges and Their Economic Consequences
additional_sources.triage: Twenty-chain/sixteen-bridge daily panels and corridor aggregates; not the missing actor-day ledger. No candidate token/address identification recovered from searchable text.
Title, authors and contents unverified. One failed fetch; no retry or access-control bypass.

provenance.hash_semantics: Markdown SHA-256 values commit to locally saved UTF-8 extracted text, not original HTTP/PDF bytes. HTML SHA-256 values commit to downloaded raw HTML. Retrieval time and content hash do not certify source truth.
provenance.backward_reference_work: Read predecessor R037 cited in R034 and newer N-Hops; examined related-work/reference sections of all priority papers. R019/R030 mentions do not count as full reads.
provenance.direct_citation_relationship_claim: These are explicitly related works/deployment documentation; no unverified claim that every newer source cites every priority paper.
